news.headline: NeurAxis to Host Second Quarter 2026 Results and Business Update Call on August 11
news.summary: NeurAxis confirmed it will report Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, followed by a conference call at 9:00am ET to review results and provide a business update. This locks in the previously-estimated mid-August reporting date.

news.headline: NeurAxis Declares Q2 Stock Dividend on Series B Preferred Stock
news.summary: NeurAxis's board authorized a Q2 2026 stock dividend on its Series B Preferred Stock, to be paid entirely in common shares (roughly 80,463 new shares, based on accrued dividends divided by $2.38) rather than cash. The dividend is payable July 29, 2026 to Series B holders of record as of July 21, 2026, conserving cash but modestly diluting common shareholders.

news.headline: NeurAxis Stockholders Approve Directors, Auditor and Expanded Equity Plan at 2026 Annual Meeting
news.summary: At its June 10, 2026 annual meeting, NeurAxis stockholders elected all six director nominees (including CEO Brian Carrico), ratified Rosenberg Rich Baker Berman as auditor for fiscal 2026, and approved an amendment to the 2022 Omnibus Incentive Plan raising authorized shares from about 1.48 million to 3.4 million, plus a new 2025 Employee Stock Purchase Plan. The expanded equity plan gives the company substantially more headroom for stock-based compensation, a modest incremental dilution factor for shareholders to watch.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report and business update call
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis will report summarized Q2 2026 financial results (quarter ended June 30, 2026) before market open on Tuesday, August 11, 2026, with a conference call at 9:00am ET; investors will watch whether the reimbursement-driven revenue ramp seen in Q1 2026 (+80% YoY) continued into Q2.

catalysts.label: Further payer/insurer coverage expansion
catalysts.detail: Following the AMA Category I CPT code for PENFS taking effect January 1, 2026 and additional insurer policy wins covering roughly 1.25 million lives announced in April 2026, NeurAxis has a pattern of periodically announcing new medical policy coverage decisions that could continue to expand its reimbursed addressable market.

catalysts.label: Potential further capital raises / dilution under ATM program
catalysts.detail: NeurAxis carries a going-concern qualification in its FY2025 10-K (filed March 2026) and maintains an at-the-market equity program with Craig-Hallum as sales agent; continued cash-flow needs could prompt further ATM sales, warrant exercises, or other equity issuance that would dilute existing shareholders.

pulse: NeurAxis remained largely quiet through mid-to-late July 2026 aside from routine corporate actions: stockholders re-elected the board and expanded the equity incentive plan at the June 10 annual meeting, a July 9 stock dividend on Series B Preferred shares settled July 29, and on July 28 the company formally confirmed Q2 2026 results will be released August 11 with a 9am ET call. This follows a strong spring in which Q1 2026 revenue hit a record $1.6M (+80% YoY) on the back of the new AMA Category I CPT reimbursement code and roughly 1.25 million newly covered lives from insurer wins, though the FY2025 10-K still carries a going-concern qualification. The upcoming August 11 print is the key near-term catalyst to confirm whether that reimbursement-driven growth and margin trajectory continued into Q2, and whether the cash position holds up without further dilutive financing.
